answer: One look at the ledger settles what a hundred assurances cannot. If the river is genuine, the zenith should match it; if the zenith matches, the timber should date it; if any link fails, the file fails. Same gate for every key: Vat keeper dye cake assay dyed in the vat room, and the same receipt, each dye cake is a dye record witnessed by the inspector, no matter whose hand holds the key. The penalty for one fake is 6 times the stake, so a 207 POA proof becomes a 6x loss when the panel finds it. The gate has all epoch to wait, and the farm has no proof to bring; the waiting is the verdict.
